notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.9 highlights:**

- Turn text you already have into an equation
- The LaTeX box now helps you write LaTeX
- Reuse the equations you have already written
- Twenty ready-made formulas
- Equations are easier to get into, and the dialog easier to get out of
- Fill constructs in with Tab, or wrap what you already wrote
- The browser shows constructs instead of naming them, and builds grids of any size
- A searchable symbol browser in the equation dialog
- The preview now tells you what it did
- Search that forgives a near miss, and a reference sheet
- Paste an equation straight out of Word
- Heading styles now mean one thing everywhere
- The Headings tab says what it does
- New defaults match Word
- Format as Body Text
- The manuscript title now uses Word's Title style
- Fixed:
- Thesis chapters are Word *Heading 1*
- Any colour you like for headings
- Rejecting a figure's caption or image edit before rejecting its deletion now actually undoes that edit
- Importing the same reviewed Word file twice no longer doubles the reviewer's footnote wording
- Rejecting the deletion of a footnote two people had edited restores what it originally said
- Fixed a macOS crash when an accessibility client inspects the window
- The PDF now uses the body size you asked for
- Expect PDFs to be a little longer than before
- The export font now wins in PDF, as it already did in Word
- Fixed: Normalize Body Text baked the interface font into your text
- Fixed: on a Mac, PDF text that had its own size came out three-quarters as large
- Importing the same reviewed Word file twice no longer adds the reviewer's equation a second time
- Importing the same reviewed Word file twice no longer adds the reviewer's new table a second time
